title: Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum Review: Hyaluronic Acid, How to Use It
description:
Dermalogica Circular Hydration Serum: a long-lasting serum that immediately floods skin with hydration, suitable for all skin types and especially dry or dehydrated skin.

We earn a commission if you buy through our link.

• Long-lasting serum that kick-starts skin's hydration cycle and immediately floods skin with hydration (10 ml, 30 ml and 59 ml)
• Suitable for all skin types, especially dryness or dehydration, dullness, fine lines or loss of firmness
• Enhanced form of hyaluronic acid penetrates the skin's surface for deep hydration
• Polyglutamic acid from fermented soy replenishes skin's hydration reserves from within
• Smooth over cleansed face and neck morning and night, after toning and before moisturizing; about 4-6 drops
• Sensitive skin: you may want to patch test first
